what: Plan initializes phase2_relaunch_count next to fallback_count after the grouped phase-2 relaunch path that increments it
scenario_or_breakage: With set -u, the first reuse_slot_result failure reaches phase2_relaunch_count=$((phase2_relaunch_count + 1)) before the variable exists, so dispatch exits instead of relaunching the slot or emitting the warning
suggested_fix: Initialize phase2_relaunch_count=0 before the grouped phase-2 loop can execute, for example before phase2_grouped_failed=(), and leave fallback_count at the phase-3 loop
